added: With Custom Figures on, Figure shorthands can also stand for one of your own figures with values you choose: typing the shorthand during free-text entry adds that figure, which becomes the figures it stands for when you save the dance.
Add `CompoundShorthands` and the `compound_shorthands` setting: whole-collection, compared token by token, and held back by the sync capability gate until every device can read the glossary.
